acceptanceCriteria.text: `compressedAsset.sha256` is required in the documented lowercase SHA-256 representation and validated structurally.
Release metadata compressed digest/size must exactly match the raw OCI layer descriptor.
Downloaded compressed bytes must exactly match both the descriptor and release metadata before decompression.
Descriptor-size mismatch, compressed digest mismatch, corrupted compressed bytes, and malformed metadata fail closed with bounded diagnostics.
The valid published Runtime Appliance shape remains accepted and idempotent reuse remains unchanged.
Publish workflow/operator documentation enforce the same compressed identity contract as the Rust consumer.
Focused tests cover every mismatch boundary above.

issue.title: fix(runtime): verify the complete Runtime Appliance OCI metadata contract
